summary: Align published source-index schema with typed historical extensions and make maintenance checks enforce that profile plus present current document identities.
revisit: Maintainers or external source-index consumers check the declared profile and typed extensions. Research outputs need not be rewritten to a new carrier; retained source records and their reading/science status stay unchanged.
acceptance: Original source-index rows remain byte-preserved; valid historical forms pass, malformed/unsupported forms and stale declared current identities are detected. Source reading, rights and scientific acceptance require their own appraisal.
